summary: Defines the BGP Encapsulation SAFI and the Tunnel Encapsulation attribute. They let BGP speakers agree on how a packet should be encapsulated when it crosses to the next hop. It was later replaced by RFC 9012.

eli5.summary: Sometimes a packet must be put in a special envelope for part of its trip. This note lets two routers agree on which envelope to use and how to open it. It was later replaced by RFC 9012.
